routes.label: Use the middle and repeated scores

question: Five test scores have a mean (average score) of \(90,\) a median (middle score) of \(91,\) and a mode (most frequent score) of \(94.\) The sum of the two lowest test scores is
solution:
Arrange the five scores from lowest to highest. The median tells us that the third score is \(91\), so only the last two scores can exceed \(91\). The mode \(94\) must repeat, and both occurrences must therefore occupy those last two positions.

The mean gives the total of all five scores:
\[
5\cdot90=450.
\]
Subtracting the three known scores leaves the sum of the two lowest scores:
\[
450-91-94-94=171.
\]
The answer is \(171\), choice \(\boxed{\text{B}}\).
